title: Arizona Revised Statutes, Title 23, Chapter 2, Article 2 - Employment of Unauthorized Aliens (Legal Arizona Workers Act)
verified_how: Fetched the Title 23 index, which lists 'Article 2: Employment of Unauthorized Aliens' within Chapter 2 (Employment Practices and Working Conditions, ss 23-201 to 23-495.01), in the compilation updated through the 57th Legislature, 2nd Regular Session.
notes: Immigration status and work authorisation themselves are federal (Immigration and Nationality Act, 8 U.S.C.; employer verification at 8 U.S.C. s 1324a). This state Act licenses-sanctions employers who knowingly employ unauthorised workers and mandates E-Verify; it was upheld as a licensing law in Chamber of Commerce v. Whiting, 563 U.S. 582 (2011). The register's title index does not print section ranges at article level.
